name: xsyte-plugins
description: Skills for building on the xsyte sports-league platform (hockeysyte, sportssyte, soccersyte)

plugins.name: xsyte-platform
plugins.description: Foundational skills for working on the xsyte platform — site chrome and Brand Kit, data-source-driven custom pages with Page Fields for club-editable values, form wiring, a verification harness that lints and measures before anything is pasted, and a season builder that sets up leagues, tournaments, teams and schedules through the site's API.
